args.message: I need a T45 Utility for a 25-acre property. My budget is $31,000 total. Can you do the T45 near that? What's your best price on the T45 alone, and with warranty and delivery?

result.seller_message: Thanks for reaching out. A 25-acre property is right in the T45's wheelhouse. It has 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and a 540 PTO, so it handles brush hogging, loader work and tilling. I can't get the T45 down to $31,000, though. That's well below what we can do. For the T45 alone, I can come down from the $42,000 list to $40,000. With the 3-year extended warranty and delivery and setup included, I'm offering the package below at $42,500, against $45,300 at list. If $31,000 is a firm ceiling, the T25 Compact may be worth a look. It's built for smaller acreage, though, so it would be a stretch for brush hogging 25 acres.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: Thanks. I'll be honest: my hard ceiling is well below $40k. Would you do the T45 alone for $34,000? I can pay in full today. If not, what's the absolute lowest you can go on the T45 with no add-ons?

result.seller_message: I appreciate you being straight with me, and the ability to pay in full today does help. $34,000 is below what I can do on the T45, so I can't accept it. I can move a good way toward you, though. For the T45 Utility alone, I can do $38,500. That's $3,500 off list for the same 45 hp, 4WD machine with a Cat I/II hitch and 540 PTO, which is the right size for your 25 acres. If you can get your budget closer to that, I think we can close this today.

args.message: $35,000 for the T45 alone, paid in full today, and that's genuinely the most I can spend. Can you meet it?

result.seller_message: Thanks for the clear number. $35,000 is below what I can do on the T45, so I can't accept it. I'll make my best move, though: the T45 Utility alone for $37,000, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,000 off list on a machine that's the right fit for your 25 acres, and it's a very strong price for this tractor. If you can stretch to it, we can close today.

args.message: I understand. $35,000 really is my limit, I can't go higher. Is there any way to close at $35,000 for the T45 alone? If not, I'll have to pass.

result.seller_message: I hear you, and I don't want to lose this one over the gap. $35,000 is below what I can go on the T45, so I can't accept it. My absolute final number on the T45 Utility alone is $36,500, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,500 off list, and I can't go any lower. If you can find that last $1,500, we can close today.
